metadata.title: The Ghost Bride's Dowry Box
metadata.subtitle: His scheming ex hid a cursed antique ring under my bridal pillow to frame me—instead the spirit hunted HER room all night.

nodes.text: 11:09 PM · Wedding night at Cliffside Villa. While guests linger by the terrace bar, Mrs. Hoa hurries out of your bridal suite, pale as chalk.
Miss {{player_name}}, do NOT touch your silk pillow! I just caught Miss Vanessa slipping out of your bridal suite with a red lacquer dowry box under her shawl!
A red lacquer dowry box? Isn’t that the antique ghost-bride chest from the cliffside museum auction last week? What did she hide under my pillow?
A tarnished silver band engraved with a 1940 wedding date! I moved it with tongs onto the dressing table—never touched it with bare hands!
Enjoy your wedding night, {{player_name}}. Hope you sleep deeply—and don’t mind if Caleb’s aunt notices her missing antique ring tomorrow morning.

nodes.prompt: You realize Vanessa tried to curse your marriage AND frame you for stealing a museum heirloom:

options.label: Warn Vanessa who touched the ring last
options.player_reply_text: Too bad I never touched it, Vanessa. Your bare fingerprints are the only skin that handled that ghost-bride’s ring tonight.

options.label: Alert Caleb to check Guest Wing B
options.player_reply_text: Caleb, Vanessa snuck into our bridal suite and planted a stolen antique silver ring under our pillow. Come upstairs right now.

nodes.text: Cute bluff! Wait—why is the red lacquer box in my suitcase suddenly rattling?! I didn’t leave anything inside it!
She did WHAT?! On our wedding night?! I’m heading straight to Guest Wing B with estate security!
11:18 PM · Sea fog swallows the cliffside balcony of Guest Wing B. Three soft fingernail taps scrape across Vanessa’s glass patio door—from the fourth-floor ledge.

nodes.headline: Tapping on the Fourth-Floor Glass
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Mrs. Hoa photographs the tarnished ring—and Vanessa’s phone receives a chilling wedding march.

nodes.text: 11:24 PM · Mrs. Hoa photographs the tarnished ring sitting untouched on the bridal vanity before sealing it in a sterile glass jar.

nodes.caption: Look closely, Mr. Caleb—the silver band is freezing cold and smells of sea salt. Miss Vanessa carried it in with her own bare hands.

nodes.text: Caleb help!! Something is scratching my fourth-floor balcony glass and my phone just played an old gramophone wedding march by itself!!
Stop screaming and open your door, Vanessa! Why is the antique dowry chest from Aunt Clara’s private collection inside your guest room?!

nodes.prompt: Vanessa’s voice note cuts through the howling cliff wind:

options.label: Ask what the ghost bride wants back
options.player_reply_text: You didn’t just take the ring out of the dowry box, Vanessa. What else did you pry off the lacquer lid?

options.label: Ask Mrs. Hoa about the 1940 legend
options.player_reply_text: Mrs. Hoa, why did Caleb’s aunt keep that dowry box locked behind triple iron bolts?

nodes.transcript: [sobbing, metallic rattling] "I pried off the jade hairpin clasp to pawn it!! The balcony curtain is moving—someone in a red veil is outside!!"

nodes.text: Because the 1940 bride never forgave the cousin who stole her dowry on her wedding eve! The spirit hunts whoever breaks the lacquer box!

nodes.headline: Red Silk Beyond the Glass
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Vanessa’s door deadbolts from the inside—and the dowry box pops open on her bed.

nodes.text: 11:36 PM · Caleb reaches Guest Room 4B with two guards. The brass handle won’t turn; icy fog leaks under the doorframe.
Break the door down!! The lacquer box just hopped off my suitcase and opened wide on the bed—and my reflection in the window is wearing a red veil!!
Put the jade hairpin back into the lacquer box, Vanessa. And tell Caleb who gave you the key to Aunt Clara’s curio vault.
I copied Aunt Clara’s vault key last month AND paid a tabloid photographer to wait outside the villa gates to catch {{player_name}} getting arrested for theft!
You hired paparazzi outside our wedding gates to frame my wife for stealing Aunt Clara’s heirlooms?!

nodes.prompt: Vanessa’s phone rings inside the fog-filled guest room:

options.label: Tell her to answer and confess
options.player_reply_text: Pick up that call, Vanessa. Lying won’t unlock Room 4B.

options.label: Send security to detain the paparazzi van
options.player_reply_text: Caleb, have the gate guards photograph the license plate of that tabloid van outside before they bolt.

nodes.text: It’s not even a real number—it just says "1940"! I’m putting the jade hairpin back in the box right now!!
Gate guards just blocked the van—the photographer already confessed Vanessa wired him $8,000 yesterday!

nodes.headline: The 1940 Line
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Through the speaker, an old gramophone stops—and the ghost bride demands the missing ring.

nodes.text: 11:49 PM · Room 4B’s window latches rattle violently. Vanessa presses both palms against the frosted bedroom door.
The voice on the call said the box is still missing the silver ring!! {{player_name}}, please bring the glass jar to my door before she opens the balcony!!
Miss {{player_name}}, if we set the glass jar down in the corridor and return the ring to the dowry box, the spirit will settle immediately.
I’m walking down to Wing B with the jar right now. On one condition, Vanessa: you confess on video to stealing Aunt Clara’s heirloom and hiring the tabloid.

nodes.prompt: Vanessa agrees instantly as the balcony latch clicks halfway open:

options.label: Make her send the sworn confession first
options.player_reply_text: Send the full confession in the family group chat right now—every name, every receipt.

options.label: Ask who helped her sneak past villa security
options.player_reply_text: And name the catering captain who gave you the bridal-suite passkey, Vanessa.

nodes.text: I CONFESS! I stole Aunt Clara’s dowry box, planted the silver ring under {{player_name}}’s pillow, and paid the tabloid $8,000 to ruin her wedding!!
It was Marco from the banquet team! I paid him $2,500 cash behind the kitchen pantry!

nodes.headline: Corridor of Wing B
nodes.teaser_text: Next: As you approach Room 4B, the hallway camera captures a towering shadow waiting silently.

nodes.text: 11:58 PM · You carry the glass jar down Guest Wing B beside Caleb. Mrs. Hoa sends a still from the hallway security monitor.

nodes.caption: Walk slowly, Miss {{player_name}}—she is waiting peacefully outside Room 4B. She knows you mean her no disrespect.

nodes.text: I’m returning your silver band with full respect. Please let this house sleep in peace tonight.
12:00 AM · Room 4B’s deadbolt clicks smoothly open. Inside, Vanessa collapses weeping beside the open red lacquer box.

nodes.prompt: You tip the silver band gently from the glass jar onto the velvet slot inside the dowry box:

options.label: Close the red lacquer lid respectfully
options.player_reply_text: Everything is back where it belongs.

options.label: Have Caleb escort Vanessa straight to police
options.player_reply_text: Now get up, Vanessa. Estate security and the police are waiting downstairs to escort you and Marco out.

nodes.text: The brass clasp shuts with a gentle click. Instantly, the sea fog outside the balcony recedes and the hallway grows warm.
Officers just walked up the stairs, {{player_name}}. Aunt Clara is pressing full felony theft charges.

nodes.headline: The Fog Recedes
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Police arrest Vanessa and the bribed banquet captain—and Aunt Clara reveals a secret.

nodes.text: 12:30 AM · Patrol cars pull away from the cliffside gates with Vanessa and the banquet captain in custody. Mrs. Hoa brings hot ginger tea to the study.
Aunt Clara just called from Paris—she’s donating the 1940 dowry box to the heritage temple tomorrow so the bride can finally be honored properly.
That’s the kindest thing anyone could do. Wait—what about the tabloid photographer Vanessa hired?
Our family attorney made him sign a sworn witness statement and delete every frame. He’s testifying against Vanessa to avoid a conspiracy charge.

nodes.prompt: Caleb wraps a warm cashmere throw around your shoulders:

options.label: Thank him for never doubting me once
options.player_reply_text: You didn’t hesitate for even a second tonight, Caleb. I married the right man.

options.label: Ask Mrs. Hoa to freshen the bridal suite
options.player_reply_text: Mrs. Hoa, could we swap out the bridal linens for fresh lavender silk? I’m ready for a real wedding night.

nodes.text: You’re my wife, {{player_name}}. Nobody lays a finger on our home.
Already done, Miss {{player_name}}! Fresh silk sheets and white lilies on the nightstand.

nodes.headline: Peace at Cliffside Villa
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Before sunrise, the heritage temple monk arrives to receive the dowry box.

nodes.text: 5:40 AM · Dawn mist glows rose-gold over the ocean. On the front portico, you hand the sealed red lacquer dowry box to the elder temple monk.
Look at the ocean breeze, Miss {{player_name}}—the air turned sweet like jasmine the moment the monk blessed the box.
She waited eighty-six years for someone to treat her dowry with respect. Now she’s free.

nodes.prompt: The temple van glides peacefully down the cliff road:

options.label: Watch the first sunrise with Caleb
options.player_reply_text: Come on, husband—let’s watch the sun come up over the water.

options.label: Send a donation to restore the 1940 memorial
options.player_reply_text: Caleb, let’s endow a permanent floral fund at the temple for the 1940 bride.

nodes.text: Golden rays break across the waves as warm morning air fills the cliffside terrace.
Consider it done. The best first gift we could give as husband and wife.

nodes.headline: The First Morning
nodes.teaser_text: Finale: Warm morning sun and ocean breeze greet your first breakfast as newlyweds.

nodes.text: 7:45 AM · Bright morning sunlight shimmers across the turquoise bay. Fresh pastries and sea-salt coffee steam on the cliffside terrace.
Morning, Mrs. {{player_name}}. Precinct just confirmed Vanessa and Marco were formally charged—our honeymoon flight leaves at noon!
Have a wonderful honeymoon, you two! Cliffside Villa has never felt brighter.

nodes.prompt: You lift your warm coffee cup toward the sparkling ocean horizon:

options.label: Clink cups with Caleb in the sunshine
options.player_reply_text: Here’s to a lifetime of sunlit mornings—and zero uninvited guests.

options.label: Smile at the white jasmine blooming by the rail
options.player_reply_text: Look, Caleb—the jasmine buds along the terrace rail all bloomed overnight.

nodes.text: Sunlight catches your diamond wedding band as gentle waves shimmer below the cliff.
A warm ocean breeze carries the sweet scent of jasmine into your brand-new life.

nodes.headline: Blessed Wedding Morning
nodes.teaser_text: You finished "The Ghost Bride’s Dowry Box"! Explore more supernatural karma stories.
